hottest.summary: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
hottest.summary_excerpt: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
hottest.title: CVE-2026-120705: OSGeo GeoServer

hottest.summary: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
hottest.summary_excerpt: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
hottest.title: CVE-2026-129243: OSGeo GeoServer
